result.planSummary: Aligned Epic 5 Story 0 foundations by slimming project artifact summaries, extending review provenance/error contracts, adding durable process package-context tables and store methods, and refreshing fixtures/tests so the new vocabulary compiles and verifies cleanly.

findingsFixed: Removed artifact ownership fields from project-shell artifact summaries/rendering while preserving process-local artifact references.
Added provenance ids/display labels to review version contracts and patched store/service/test scaffolding to emit them consistently.
Added durable process package-context tables plus store methods with canonical upsert/idempotent semantics.
Fixed the production-shell integration assertion to resolve the built asset from the active worktree instead of a hard-coded sibling checkout path.

specDeviations: Browser-facing package member contracts still expose legacy `versionId`; Story 0 added the durable/package-context `artifactVersionId` vocabulary and deferred the surface rename to avoid wider Story 3/4 regressions.
Review target schemas still accept legacy `REVIEW_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` alongside `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` as a compatibility bridge for existing package review flows.
result.recommendedNextStep: Implement Story 1 against the new project-scoped artifact summary and package-context foundation.
